23:28.text: And when you have embarked on the ship, you and whoever is with you, then say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Who has saved us from the people who are Zâlimûn
(i.e. oppressors, wrong-doers, polytheists, those who join others in worship with Allâh)

23:29.text: And say: "My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for You are the Best of those who bring to land."

23:30.text: [what We did as regards drowning of the people of Nûh (Noah)]
(proofs, evidence, lessons, signs, etc. for men to understand)
, for sure We are ever putting

23:31.text: Then, after them, We created another generation.

23:32.text: And We sent to them a Messenger from among themselves
: "Worship Allâh! You have no other Ilâh
but Him. Will you not then be afraid
(of Him i.e. of His punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)

23:33.text: And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and whom We had given the luxuries and comforts of this life, said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he eats of that which you eat, and drinks of what you drink.

23:34.text: "If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, then verily you indeed would be losers.

23:35.text: "Does he promise you that when you have died and have become dust and bones, you shall come out alive

23:36.text: "Far, very far is that which you are promised!

23:37.text: "There is nothing but our life of this world! We die and we live! And we are not going to be resurrected!

23:38.text: "He is only a man who has invented a lie against Allâh, and we are not going to believe in him."

23:39.text: He said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me."

23:40.text: said: "In a little while, they are sure to be regretful."

23:41.text: , and We made them as rubbish of dead plants. So away with the people who are Zâlimûn
(polytheists, wrong-doers, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, disobedient to His Messengers)

23:42.text: Then, after them, We created other generations.
